title: Crazy Craft SMP
description: Basic modpack for our Crazy Craft SMP!
body:
## Crazy Craft SMP Modpack

**Welcome to the official Crazy Craft SMP Season 2 modpack!**

We've created this lightweight **starter pack** so everyone can jump straight into the server without having to search for the right mods themselves. Simply install the pack, launch the game, and you're **ready to start your adventure**.

---

![Crazy Craft SMP S2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/26020e07cbc7fdf47f19ec94f8e6d88842c15a1d.png)

---

### ✨ Why use this modpack?

⚡ **Optimized performance** – smooth gameplay, faster loading times, and stable FPS.  
🧩 **Built for every playstyle** – perfect for survival, building, exploring and events.  
🎮 **Easy setup** – all required client-side mods are already included, so you can start playing right away.  

---

### ❤️ A big thank you to the mod creators

This modpack wouldn't be possible without the amazing work of the many talented mod developers in the Minecraft community. **Thank you** for your time, passion, and dedication to creating the mods that make experiences like Crazy Craft SMP possible!

---

### 🗺️ Crazy Craft SMP Season 2 Features

Our server also includes several extra features that are not included in this download, such as:

🔥 Fire spread disabled  
🌙 One-player sleep  
📍 Toggleable coordinates with /trigger ch_toggle  
🛡️ Anti-Enderman grief protection  
🌀 Custom Nether portals  
💀 Collectible mob heads and mini blocks  
🍂 Fast leaf decay  
⚰️ Graves system  


(Datapacks provided by **[Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/)**.)

---

### 💻 Want to join?

The Crazy Craft SMP is a **whitelist-only** community server.  
**[Join our Discord](https://discord.gg/McRSnK3agZ)**, apply for access, and become part of our community!

---

💡 **Note**

While this is the **official starter pack** for Crazy Craft SMP Season 2, you're also welcome to use it for your own survival world, private SMP, or adventures with friends.
